patterns.note: An extremely minimalist layout featuring a full-bleed hero image or video that dominates the initial viewport, with minimal overlay text.
All textual elements, including navigation, body, and labels, consistently use a small, understated sans-serif typeface, often in uppercase, with generous letter-spacing.
A stark, high-contrast palette dominated by white or very light off-white backgrounds and dark grey or black text, allowing product imagery to provide the primary color accents.
The main hero visual (model) subtly zooms in or scales up as the user scrolls down the page, creating a gentle parallax-like effect that draws attention to the subject.
A fixed header and footer are present on the initial load, with the footer then scrolling up with the page content as the user progresses down.

technique_notes: Implement a subtle, slow-motion zoom or scale transformation on the primary hero image or video element, synchronized with the scroll position, to create a sense of depth and focus. This can be achieved using a scroll-triggered animation library like locomotive-scroll or GSAP.
Design with an abundance of whitespace around all elements, particularly in the hero and footer areas, to convey a sense of luxury and exclusivity. Content sections are sparse and highly focused.
Utilize a consistent, small-scale sans-serif typography system across all text, including navigation, headings, and body copy, to maintain an understated and elegant brand voice.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, consistent sans-serif for all text elements, with very little size variation between headings and body, emphasizing a quiet, uniform presence.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, characterized by generous padding and line-heights, especially in the hero and footer, creating a sense of spaciousness and calm.

standout: The site's extreme minimalism and almost complete absence of typical marketing content, relying instead on a single, high-quality, full-bleed visual and subtle scroll-triggered motion to convey luxury and brand identity. It feels more like an art installation or gallery than a traditional e-commerce site.
